[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) : List Nat :=
let not_map := fun
  | "o" => 4
  | "o|" => 2
  | ".|" => 1
  | _ => 0
let chars := string.to_list
let rec parse (chars: List Char) (acc: List Nat) : List Nat :=
  match chars with
  | [] => acc
  | head :: tail =>
    let note := string.of_list (List.takeWhile (· ≠ ' ') chars)
    let beats := not_map note
    parse (List.dropWhile (· ≠ ' ') tail) (beats :: acc)
parse chars []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma not_map_correct
(note: String)
: not_map note = String.mapi not_map' note
where
  not_map' := fun i c =>
    if c = 'o' then 4
    else if c = 'o|' then 2
    else if c = ".|" then 1
    else 0
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_split := string.splitOn " " result
split
-- length of space_split = length of result
apply List.ext
intro i
have h_char := h_split i
have h_space_split := h_char.1
have h_result := h_char.2
simp [h_space_split, h_result]
-- not_map (space_split.get! i) = result.get! i
rw [List.get_eq_item, List.get_eq_nth]
simp [h_space_split]
have h_note := h_split i.1
have h_beats := h_split i.2
rw [List.get_eq_item, List.get_eq_nth]
have h_note_correct := not_map_correct h_note
simp [h_note_correct]
simp [h_beats]
[END]
